appointments.description: BOOKED appointments whose door window starts in [window_start, window_end).

labour_minutes.description: Labour minutes the declared standard attributes to them; 0 when none is declared (never a guessed default).

average_heads.description: labour_minutes over the window length, in people.

standard_missing.description: Appointments exist but no standard is declared for (location, path_id).

as_of.description: CloudEvents time of the newest dock appointment event the site's model reflects; null when none.

400.description: location or path_id missing, window_start/window_end missing or not RFC 3339, or a window whose end is not after its start.
